title: Kagel Canyon Park Playground Ribbon Cutting 8/29/26
description:
Families in Lake View Terrace have a brand-new place to play!

Los Angeles City Councilwoman Monica Rodriguez joined the Department of Recreation and Parks, local students, and community members to celebrate the grand reopening of the renovated playground at Kagel Canyon Park.

Completed in just over two months with a $438,000 investment, the upgraded playground features ADA-accessible equipment, age-appropriate play structures, imaginative play features, and a much-needed shade canopy to help children stay comfortable in the Valley heat.

The ribbon-cutting marked another investment in safe, inclusive neighborhood parks where children can play, families can connect, and lifelong memories can take shape.
